ceiling_label: CEILING: every metric here is an IN-SAMPLE CEILING on the same history the periods were fit on. The oracle buys the whole book all-in on every pinned buy date and sells all-out on every pinned sell date, so it measures PERIOD QUALITY, never achievable performance — real DCA drips and cannot buy one close. Only the split-sample read (fit on the first half, score on the unseen second half) says anything out-of-sample-ish, and both sides must be read next to this sentence.
objective_label: frozen objective: maximize oracle Sharpe, tie-break Calmar, then CAGR, subject to a time-in-market floor of 70.0% of days (period_optimize.EXPOSURE_FLOOR_PCT / rank_period_scores)
risk_conventions_label: risk-adjusted conventions (sdca/risk_metrics.py): simple per-day returns, annualization 252, risk-free 0, drawdown reused from walk_forward.
holdout_note: in-sample by construction: this run scores the FULL cached GLD history, the same history the periods are derived from. No separate holdout segment was carved out or touched; the split-sample pair below is the only out-of-sample-ish read.
